title: PID Controller (2DOF)
text: Continuous-time or discrete-time two-degree-of-freedom PID controller, 18 inputs, 2 outputs, no direct feedthrough, {Integral (I)} sets Integral gain; {Controller}, {Form} sets the controller structure, {Time domain} sets the continuous-time or discrete-time controller, {PID Controller is inside a conditionally executed subsystem} enables the discrete-integrator time port, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the discrete interval between, {Integrator method} sets the method for computing integral in discrete-time controller Forward, {Filter method} sets the method for computing derivative in discrete-time controller Forward, {Source}, {Proportional (P)} sets the proportional gain, {Integral (I*Ts)} sets the integral gain multiplied by sample time, {Use I*Ts} uses integral gain multiplied by sample, {Derivative (D)} sets the derivative gain, {Use externally sourced derivative} sets the derivative at block input port, {Use filtered derivative} applies filter to derivative term, {Filter coefficient (N)} sets the derivative filter coefficient, {Setpoint weight (b)} sets the proportional setpoint weight, {Setpoint weight (c)} sets the derivative setpoint weight, {Select tuning method} sets the tool for automatic tuning of controller coefficients Transfer Function, {Enable zero-crossing detection} sets the detect zero crossings on reset and on entering or leaving a saturation, {Integrator}, {Filter}, {Differentiator} sets the initial condition for unfiltered, {Initial condition setting} sets the location at which initial condition, {External reset} sets the trigger for resetting integrator and filter, {Ignore reset when linearizing} sets the force linearization to ignore reset, {Enable tracking mode} sets the activate signal tracking, {Tracking coefficient (Kt)} sets the gain of signal-tracking feedback loop, {Limit Output} limits block output to specified saturation, {Upper limit} sets the upper saturation limit for block output, {Lower limit} sets the lower saturation limit for block output, {Ignore saturation when linearizing} sets the force linearization to ignore output, {Anti-windup method} sets the integrator anti-windup method, {Back-calculation coefficient (Kb)} sets the gain coefficient of anti-windup feedback, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action, {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data, {State name (e.g., ’position’)} sets the name for continuous-time filter and integrator, {State name} sets the names for discrete-time filter and integrator states empty and {State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} requires that state name resolve to a signal. Values come from the instance.
